<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
	xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
	
	<modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>
    <groupId>com.dukascopy.dds2</groupId>
    <artifactId>msg</artifactId>
    <name>Msg</name>
    <version>1.1.98.2-JForex3</version>
    
    <organization>
		<name>Dukascopy</name>
		<url>http://www.dukascopy.com</url>
	</organization>
    <contributors>
        <contributor>
            <name>Dukascopy employees</name>
        </contributor>
        <contributor>
            <name>Mark Vilkel</name>
        </contributor>
    </contributors>
    
    <scm>
        <connection>scm:git:https://gitbucket.site.dukascopy.com/git/JAVA-TRANSPORT/msg.git</connection>
    </scm>
    
    <distributionManagement>
       <repository>
            <id>dukascopy</id>
            <name>Dukascopy releases</name>
            <url>https://artifactory.site.dukascopy.com/artifactory/dukascopy</url>
        </repository>
       <snapshotRepository>
           <id>dukascopy</id>
           <name>Dukascopy snapshots</name>
           <url>https://artifactory.site.dukascopy.com/artifactory/dukascopy-snapshots</url>
        </snapshotRepository>  
    </distributionManagement>
    <properties>
        <project.build.sourceEncoding>UTF-8</project.build.sourceEncoding>
    </properties>
    <build>
        <sourceDirectory>src/main/generated-java</sourceDirectory>
        <plugins>
            <plugin>
                <artifactId>maven-clean-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>2.6.1</version>
                <inherited>true</inherited>
                <configuration>
                    <filesets>
                        <fileset>
                            <directory>./src/main/generated-java</directory>
                        </fileset>
                        <fileset>
                            <directory>./src/main/generated-cpp</directory>
                        </fileset>
                    </filesets>
                </configuration>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <artifactId>maven-compiler-plugin</artifactId>
                <inherited>true</inherited>
                <version>3.2</version>
                <configuration>
                    <source>8</source>
                    <target>8</target>
                </configuration>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
                <artifactId>message-generator-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>1.3.10</version>
                <executions>
                    <execution>
                        <goals>
                            <goal>generate</goal>
                        </goals>
                    </execution>
                </executions>
                <configuration>
                    <messageFolder>src/main/resources</messageFolder>
                    <outputFolder>src/main/generated-java</outputFolder>
                    <cppOutputFolder>src/main/generated-cpp</cppOutputFolder>
                    <dictionaryPackage>com.dukascopy.dds3.transport.common.protocol.binary</dictionaryPackage>
                    <messageRegistryPackage>com.dukascopy.dds3.transport.common.protocol.json</messageRegistryPackage>
                    <generateIdsForCppPrimitives>false</generateIdsForCppPrimitives>
                    <projectName>DDS3</projectName>
                    <parentStaticMessageDictionary>com.dukascopy.dds4.transport.common.protocol.binary.StaticSessionDictionary</parentStaticMessageDictionary>
                    <parentPojoToJsonMessageRegistry>com.dukascopy.dds4.transport.common.protocol.json.PojoToJsonMessageRegistry</parentPojoToJsonMessageRegistry>
                </configuration>
            </plugin>
            <plugin>
        		<artifactId>maven-resources-plugin</artifactId>
        		<version>3.0.1</version>
        		<executions>
          			<execution>
            			<id>copy-cpp-sources</id>
            			<!-- here the phase you need -->
            			<phase>process-classes</phase>
            			<goals>
              				<goal>copy-resources</goal>
            			</goals>
            			<configuration>
              				<outputDirectory>${basedir}/target/classes</outputDirectory>
              				<resources>          
                				<resource>
                  					<directory>./src/main/generated-cpp</directory>
                				</resource>
              				</resources>              
            			</configuration>            
          			</execution>
        		</executions>
      		</plugin>
            <plugin>
                <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
                <artifactId>maven-jar-plugin</artifactId>
                <version>2.5</version>
                <configuration>
                    <archive>
                    	<index>true</index>
						<manifestEntries>
							<Permissions>all-permissions</Permissions>
							<Codebase>*</Codebase>
							<Application-Name>${project.name}</Application-Name>
						</manifestEntries>
                    </archive>
              		<excludes>
              			<exclude>**/*.h</exclude>
           				<exclude>**/*.xml</exclude>
           				<exclude>**/*.xsd</exclude>
              		</excludes>
                </configuration>
                <executions>
          			<execution>
            			<id>cpp</id>
            			<goals><goal>jar</goal></goals>
            			<phase>package</phase>
            			<configuration>
              				<classifier>cpp</classifier>
              				<excludes>
              					<exclude>**/*.class</exclude>
           						<exclude>**/*.xml</exclude>
           						<exclude>**/*.xsd</exclude>
              				</excludes>
            			</configuration>
          			</execution>
        		</executions>
            </plugin>
        </plugins>
    </build>
    <dependencies>
        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.dukascopy</groupId>
            <artifactId>system-msg</artifactId>
            <version>1.0.32</version>
        </dependency>
    </dependencies>
</project>
